statement: At matched mean exposure, posterior precision about efficacy rises with the variance of the exposure
The matched fixed-k design is the only singular one
metric: fraction singular: fixed vs varied designs

statement: Policy-induced information explains how accurate a person's efficacy belief becomes, beyond where they started
metric: delta adj-R2 from adding Var(k) and policy EIG (target: |E[p]-p*|)

statement: Non-circular form: WITHIN strata matched on severity, individuals whose behaviour varies more hold more precise beliefs about their own efficacy
metric: corr(Var(k), SD[p|D]) within every severity stratum

statement: Unstratified, variability also tracks precision, but this is partly mechanical
metric: corr(Var(k), SD[p|D]) in the whole population
